judgment.reason: Its sufficiency rests entirely on an unproved and false packing-coloring lemma. A reciprocal-sum condition does not generally yield such a partition of Z^2; discrete Euclidean exclusion constraints invalidate the stated torus-packing assertion.
The claimed periodic packing lemma is neither proved nor true as stated, so the existence argument for 1<c<2 has a material fatal gap.
The asserted standard coloring lemma is false in this generality; the sketch does not establish it. Thus the claimed sufficiency is unsupported.
The finite packing-coloring lemma used for sufficiency is false as stated and is only asserted, not rigorously derived. Therefore this is not a complete proof.
